title: Bright and pretty
text: Bright and pretty. These are very pretty. Unfortunately, they didn't work for me. They developed stress fractures because I washed them in the dishwasher. If you wash your dishes by hand these should get 5 stars.

product_metadata.title: Enesco Designs by Lolita Best of the Bunch Acrylic Stemless Wine Glasses, Set of 2, 17 oz.
features: Designs by Lolita “Best of the Bunch” stemless wine glasses
Set of 2 comes ready to gift in clear window packaging
Dishwasher safe, top rack only; hand wash recommended
description: Designs by Lolita are colorful combinations of fun, entertainment and celebration well spent with the special people in our lives. These poppy-print stemless wine glasses are perfect for summer, or a warm reminder of it. Stunning hues cement that you and the ones you’re drinking with are indeed the best of the bunch. About Us: Enesco is committed to BRING JOY EVERY DAY. The premier global destination for high-quality giftware, and home décor, our prestigious family of brands includes: Department 56 Village, Gregg Gift, Foundations, Jim Shore Heartwood Creek, Disney Traditions by Jim Shore, Disney Showcase Collection, Disney by Britto, Designs by Lolita, Our Name Is Mud, and many more.
